blocks.text: The traits which are controlled by alleles present on sex chromosomes are called sex-linked traits and the phenomenon is called sex linkage. The sex-liked trait is actually X-linked because usually the Y chromosome carries almost no functional genes. That’s why, the ratio of sex-linked traits is different in males and females. However, the alleles of very few traits are found on both X and Y. Such traits are equally distributed among males and females and are called X-Y-linked or pseudo-autosomal traits.
